title: Migration
description: A cinematic orchestral journey inspired by the great annual migration of wildebeest, zebras and gazelles from the Serengeti to the Maasai Mara, crossing dangerous landscapes, predators, rivers and changing weather.
intro: A cinematic journey across the Serengeti and Maasai Mara

sections.title: The Story
sections.body:
Migration follows the great annual trek of wildebeest, zebras and gazelles from the Serengeti in Tanzania to the Maasai Mara in Kenya.

Across roughly 1,000 km, the journey is shaped by predators, river crossings, weather and climate, turning survival into a cinematic expedition across East Africa.
